artifact.category_tag: Minimum sumset size in abelian groups
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a finite abelian group (written additively) and let A ⊆ G be a subset of size m. For a positive integer h, define the following sumsets:

• Unrestricted h-fold sumset: hA = {a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_h : a_i ∈ A} (repetitions allowed).
• Restricted h-fold sumset: ĥA = {a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_h : a_i ∈ A, a_i pairwise distinct}.
• Unrestricted signed h-fold sumset: h_±A = {ε_1 a_1 + ⋯ + ε_h a_h : a_i ∈ A, ε_i ∈ {+1,−1}}.
• Restricted signed h-fold sumset: ĥ_±A = {ε_1 a_1 + ⋯ + ε_h a_h : a_i ∈ A pairwise distinct, ε_i ∈ {+1,−1}}.

For a nonnegative integer s, set [0,s]A = ⋃_{h=0}^{s} hA, and analogously [0,s]_±A, [0,s]̂A, [0,s]̂_±A. Set ⟨A⟩ = ⋃_{h≥0} hA (the subgroup generated by A together with 0), ΣA = ⋃_{h≥0} ĥA, and Σ_±A = ⋃_{h≥0} ĥ_±A.

Define the minimum-size functions
  ρ(G,m,h) = min{|hA| : A ⊆ G, |A| = m},
  ρ(G,m,[0,s]) = min{|[0,s]A| : A ⊆ G, |A| = m},
  ρ(G,m,N_0) = min{|⟨A⟩| : A ⊆ G, |A| = m},
and analogously ρ_±(G,m,·), ρ̂(G,m,·), ρ̂_±(G,m,·) using the signed, restricted, and restricted signed sumsets respectively (with the convention that the "N_0" version uses ⟨A⟩, ΣA, and Σ_±A respectively).

Problem: For every finite abelian group G and every integer m with 1 ≤ m ≤ |G|, determine the exact values of the four families of functions ρ, ρ_±, ρ̂, ρ̂_± (evaluated at h, at [0,s], and at N_0), and, where possible, characterize all subsets A ⊆ G of size m attaining these minima.
artifact.status_search_result: This is a longstanding family of open problems in additive combinatorics. Exact values of ρ, ρ_±, ρ̂, ρ̂_± are known only in special cases (e.g., classical Cauchy–Davenport, Kneser, Vosper, Freiman-type results, and partial results of Bajnok and others for cyclic groups and certain ranges of h, m, s). The full determination across all finite abelian groups, all parameters, and all four sumset variants remains open, and the problem family continues to attract research.
